data.hook: Double-layer NOX Fit Pro shorts in bold red, with a secure back pocket.
why: Double-layer design with a built-in inner short
High waistband with a zipped back pocket for keys or a card
data.summary: NOX Fit Pro shorts for women, ideal for padel: breathable, with a double-layer design and a high, supportive waistband.

faq.q: Can I try the shorts on before buying?
faq.a: Yes. Tap "Keep it ready for me to see" and we'll have your size at the front desk to try on.
At the club front desk, the same way you pay for court bookings. There is no online payment.

data.clubTake: Brand new. A great match-day short.
